title: Ensure crypto subpolicy and system-wide policy
description: Ensures a specified crypto subpolicy module (.pmod) exists with required lines and the system-wide crypto policy includes it. Creates/modifies the file and applies the policy if necessary, then reboots.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the target Linux server.

parameters.name: crypto_policy
parameters.description: The system‑wide crypto policy to apply (e.g. DEFAULT).

parameters.name: subpolicy_name
parameters.description: Name of the subpolicy module (without .pmod extension).

parameters.name: subpolicy_lines
parameters.description: Comma‑separated list of lines to write into the .pmod file. Example: 'hash = -SHA1,sign = -*-SHA1,sha1_in_certs = 0'.

playbook_output.description: Reports the status of the subpolicy file and the crypto policy after execution.

fields.name: file_status
fields.description: Whether the subpolicy file was created or was already present. One of 'created' or 'already present'.

fields.name: policy_status
fields.description: Whether the crypto policy was applied or was already in effect. One of 'applied' or 'already in effect'.

steps.name: Gather subpolicy file stat
steps.function: Check if the subpolicy .pmod file already exists.

steps.name: Initialize file‑needs‑create flag
steps.function: Set the default assumption that the file does not need to be created.

steps.name: Does the subpolicy file exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the .pmod file already exists on disk.

steps.name: Read existing subpolicy file
steps.function: Slurp the content of the existing .pmod file for comparison.

steps.name: Set file‑needs‑create to true
steps.function: Mark that the file must be created because it does not exist.

steps.name: Compare file content with expected lines
steps.function: Decode the slurped file, split into lines, and compare with the expected subpolicy lines. Update _file_needs_create if content differs.

computations._file_content_match: Decode _file_content_raw.content from base64, split into lines, strip whitespace, and compare sorted list with sorted _expected_lines. True if they match exactly.
computations._file_needs_create: True if _file_content_match is false, otherwise keep the current _file_needs_create value.

steps.name: Get current system-wide crypto policy
steps.function: Run update-crypto-policies --show to capture the currently active policy string.

steps.name: Check if subpolicy is already applied
steps.function: Parse the output of update-crypto-policies --show and determine whether the subpolicy_name already appears in the colon‑separated policy list.

computations._policy_already_applied: True if subpolicy_name is present in the colon‑separated list obtained from _current_policy_raw.stdout.

steps.name: Aggregate pre-checks
steps.function: Combine the file creation need and policy applied status into a single set for the following decision.

steps.name: Are both file and policy already correct?
steps.function: If the subpolicy file is already correct and the policy already includes the subpolicy, skip all remaining actions and emit the result immediately.
steps.condition: Both the subpolicy file is correct (_file_needs_create is false) and the system-wide crypto policy already includes the subpolicy (_policy_already_applied is true).

steps.name: Write subpolicy .pmod file
steps.function: Create or overwrite the subpolicy .pmod file with the required lines, creating parent directories if needed.

steps.name: Mark file creation performed
steps.function: Record that the subpolicy file was created or updated.

steps.name: Apply system-wide crypto policy
steps.function: Execute update-crypto-policies --set to activate the crypto policy with the subpolicy.

steps.name: Mark policy application performed
steps.function: Record that the crypto policy was applied.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the target server to make the new crypto policy effective for running services.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the final result with file and policy status.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Check subpolicy file existence, compare content, and verify current crypto policy status.

phases.name: Apply changes
phases.description: Create/modify the subpolicy file, apply the crypto policy, and reboot the server.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the final structured result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
